claim: Patchline ships a deterministic replay of any agent session reproducing every decision from logs. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the deterministic replay claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make agent-deterministic-replay-gate`.
